title: FBI-UAP-D016, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-1, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: An artist's digital rendering (illustration) — not a photograph or sensor capture — depicting a reported UAP incident.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from the file; all details derive from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the document body.
This is an artist's interpretation, not a photograph or sensor capture — it depicts what an observer described, not verified physical evidence.
Single-source: the depiction rests on one federal agent's first-hand account (see DOW-UAP-D080), which is unverified.
The rendering was produced in 2026, roughly three years after the October 2023 events it depicts, introducing potential recollection and reconstruction bias.
The exact location is withheld — described only as 'near a sensitive national security site' in the western United States.
